description: The crypto market's Fear & Greed index (alternative.me), 0 extreme fear to 100 extreme greed, updated once a day: today's value and label, yesterday, a week and a month ago, the 7-day change and the 30-day average. Use to gauge the whole market's mood. Not for one coin's positioning (use get_open_interest_and_long_short_ratio). No inputs. A mood figure, not a signal on its own. Next: get_market_signal_score.
name: get_fear_and_greed_index
